subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: Inanna's Descent
description: A short lesson to help you apply Inanna's Descent.

hook.text: Inanna, Queen of Heaven, descended to the underworld to visit her dead sister. She didn't expect the cost.

buildup.text: At each of seven gates, she surrendered one piece of her royal clothing. She arrived stripped and naked.

discovery.text: Her sister Ereshkigal killed her and hung her corpse on a hook. Power means nothing in the land of death.

twist.text: Inanna returned—but someone had to take her place. Her husband Dumuzi was dragged below as substitute.

climax.text: This is history's oldest written descent. It teaches that leaving the underworld always has a price.

punchline.text: You can leave death. But not for free.

quiz.question: What happened to Inanna at each gate of the underworld?
options: She surrendered one piece of clothing
